context: INISTRATION Dosage may be adjusted according to the conditions and severity of symptoms. Hyoscyamine Sulfate Orally Disintegrating Tablets, 0.125 mg must be placed on the tongue when it will dissolve in seconds, then swallow with saliva. Administering with liquid is not necessary.
